question: Would you rather discover that humanity is entirely alone in the universe or discover that we share it with thousands of advanced civilizations?
Would you rather give up all modern digital technology or give up the ability to ever experience wild nature again?
Would you rather have a perfect memory or be able to forget anything you wanted at will?
Would you rather always feel understood or always feel appreciated?
Would you rather time travel to the past or future?
Would you rather have unlimited knowledge or unlimited creativity?
Would you rather have the ability to hit pause or rewind on your life?
Would you rather fight 100 duck-sized elephants or one elephant-sized duck?
Would you rather have the ability to see minutes into the future or years into the future?
Would you rather be royalty 100 years ago or an average person today?
Would you rather cuddle a koala or pal around with a panda?
Would you rather be forced to live the same day over again for a year, or take years off the end of your life?
Would you rather get a paper cut between your fingers every time you turn a page or bite your tongue every time you eat food?
Would you rather win $1,000, or your best friend win $100,000?
Would you rather poop in the only toilet at a party knowing that you'll clog it, or poop in the bushes in the backyard?
Would you rather be extremely wealthy or extremely wise?
Would you rather never have to sleep or never have to eat?
Would you rather be able to teleport to anywhere you want, or be able to read minds?
Would you rather have all future happy moments be happier, or sad moments less sad?
Would you rather wrestle a bear or an alligator?
Would you rather be trapped in a small room with 10,000 tarantulas for 10 minutes, or eat 10 tarantulas in 100 minutes?
Would you rather be an unknown superhero or a famous villain?
Would you rather let a spider climb over you or let a snake slither across you?
Would you rather sing well and dance poorly or sing poorly and dance well?
Would you rather be able to take back anything you say or listen in on every conversation that’s about you?
Would you rather have friendships that feel effortless or ones that feel intense but meaningful?
Would you rather have every lie you’ve told this year revealed or every screenshot you’ve taken this year shared?
Would you rather always feel like you’re about to sneeze or always have an itch just out of scratching reach?
Would you rather date someone who hates dogs or someone who has three dogs with them at most times?
Would you rather talk like Minnie Mouse when you’re angry or laugh just like Spongebob?
Would you rather get the hiccups every other hour or have to end every sentence you speak with “I do declare”?
Would you rather have teeth that glow in the dark or eyebrows that fall off once a month?
Would you rather be able to communicate telepathically or know every single language on the planet?
Would you rather be constantly sticky or constantly itchy?
Would you rather have a resting confused face or a resting smug face?
Would you rather have more time or more money?
Would you rather travel back in time to meet your ancestors or travel forward in time to meet your descendants?
Would you rather let bygones be bygones or get the final word?
Would you rather be extremely talented at one thing only or pretty decent at a large number of things?
Would you rather be able to see other people’s futures or be able to see your own?
Would you rather be endlessly lucky or know you’ve earned everything you’ve achieved?
Would you rather be practical to a fault or idealistic to a fault?
Would you rather live a life that makes sense or one that surprises you?
Would you rather fall in love with a famous musician or a famous chef?
Would you rather talk to animals or be able to fly?
Would you rather not know what you’re doing tomorrow for 10 years or know exactly what you’re doing every day for the next 10 years?
Would you rather wake up in the morning as a bird or a dolphin?
Would you rather live in a world where there is no crime or no privacy?
Would you rather live in a future where people take everything too seriously or a future where people don't take anything seriously?
Would you rather always have to wear orange Crocs or Big Red Boots?
